newsitem.title: USA: Endorex plans private stock placement.
newsitem.headline: Endorex plans private stock placement.

text.p: Endorex Corp said Friday it plans to raise up to $4 million in a private placement of securities to accredited individuals and institutional investors.

The proceeds of the offering will be used to further its drug development programs, to fund its new majority-owned subsidiary, Orasomal Technologies Inc, and for general corporate purposes and working capital, Endorex said.

The securities will not have been registered under the Securities Act or state securities laws at the time of the private placement, and may not be offered or sold without registration under them or available exemptions, the company said.
Endorex is a biotechnology company. It recently changed its name from ImmunoTherapeutics Inc.
